asked.item: Telling audience comments from own replies

verdict.reason: The query parameter list has no isAuthor filter, and the comment object documents isAuthor for telling audience comments from your own.

steps.text: The List Comments query parameters are limit, cursor, platform, accountId, parentCommentId, postId, since, and until, and isAuthor is not one of them.
Each comment in the response has an isAuthor field, which is false for an audience reply and true when your connected account wrote the comment.
